player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}).
Submit moves as '[a2 a3]' (from → to).
- A normal move is one forward step to an adjacent empty vertex.
- A capture is a jump over an adjacent enemy piece landing on the empty node beyond.
Each capture yields {score_per_capture} points.
Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move.

invalid_move.bad_format: Tsarin da ba daidai ba. Yi amfani da "[a2 a3]".
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Tushen ba kayan aikinka ba ne.
invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Ba a bar wurin da aka nufa a banza ba.

game_action.captured: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya kama wani yanki! (+{score_per_capture})

outcome.cannot_move: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ba zai iya motsawa ba.
